violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Equipment and utensils were not being sanitized at the dish machine due to the sanitizer being empty.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. The PIC replaced the sanitizer and primed the dishmachine during the inspection to correct. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut romaine lettuce in the Silver King refrigerated drawers unit was 46ºF.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC moved the product to the walk-in and adjusted the holding temperature of the unit.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The dishwashing machine was not operating properly due to the sanitizer bucket being empty.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. The PIC replaced the sanitizer bucket and primed the machine during the inspection to correct. CDI.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: Observed a hose attached to the mop sink faucet. The hose is too long and extends into the sink basin.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. To correct, please cut the hose so that it hangs above the flood level rim of the sink. The PIC cut the hose during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: There was no hot water provided at the handsink located under the glove storage area. The hot water temperature was 63ºF.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. The manger corrected this by adjusting the hot water valve next to the mixing valve under the sink. The hot water was 105ºF after this adjustment. CDI.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: The electric paper towel dispenser in the men’s restroom was not working, so no paper towels were available.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The person in charge corrected this by placing a roll of paper towels on top of the dispenser and submitting a work order to have the dispenser checked and repaired.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: farro 49F, corn 45F, feta 51F, cut lettuce 52F in unit (5) prep rail (top).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PICs last line check approx 2 hours previous. Items moved to freezer to rapidly cool.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly: (5) 4DRW Prep (top rail) at 48F. Temperature display was flashing a high temp warning during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC adjusted temperature, decreased temp in prep rail to 33F.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed a hose attached to the mop sink faucet fixture. The hose extended below the flood rim level of the sink basin.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. The hose end was hung around fixture. Recommended to cut hose to above flood level of the sink rim.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. Facility has an active food establishment permit.
violations.corrective_action: EHS provided HD number for obtaining another food establishment permit to be mailed to physical location.
